env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/go.mod
exists out/pkg/pkg.go
! grep -rE 'const (map|\*)' out
grep 'func Get\(m map\[string\]int, c \*Config\) int' out/pkg/pkg.go
grep 'func helper\(m map\[string\]int, c \*Config\) int' out/pkg/pkg.go
grep 'var Table map\[string\]int' out/pkg/pkg.go
grep 'var Def \*Config' out/pkg/pkg.go
cd out
go build ./...
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/consterase

go 1.27

-- m/pkg/pkg.lgo --
package pkg

type Config struct {
	Name string
	N    int
}

func Get(m const map[string]int, c const *Config) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range m {
		n += v
	}
	if c != nil {
		n += c.N
	}
	return n
}

func helper(m const map[string]int, c const *Config) int {
	return Get(m, c)
}

var Table const map[string]int = map[string]int{"a": 1}

var Def const *Config = &Config{Name: "d", N: 2}

-- m/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/consterase/pkg"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(pkg.Get(map[string]int{"a": 1}, nil))
	fmt.Println(pkg.Get(pkg.Table, pkg.Def))
}
